results.title: Siteprint: Measure any website's design, then hand it to your AI | Product Hunt
results.content:
What you get is a prompt written for agents, not a list of colors. Every color comes with its role, the type scale with exact sizes and weights, plus corners, spacing and a blueprint of each section. Paste it into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any other AI tool and it builds from real measurements instead of a guess.

Inspect is free and measures a site's colors, type, spacing and layout, and your Library keeps the designs you like for later. Pro adds the prompt and DESIGN.md, ready-made themes, lets your agent read your scans directly via MCP, and mixes two sites into a new style with Compose.

It's a one-time $9.99 with no account.

Any feedback helps, cheers!

Asad M. [...] Filip Papic

Hi everyone, I'm the maker of Siteprint.

I'll be upfront: tools that generate design prompts and pull colors, fonts from a website aren't new, and Chrome has dozens of them. But I spend my day in Safari, and I wanted one that feels at home there instead of switching browsers. So I built it as a proper Safari extension.

Being a Safari extension also brings a built-in upgrade: Apple Intelligence. On a Mac that has it, the on-device model reviews each scan, names its colors and type styles, describes the feel and what to keep or avoid, and answers your questions about the design. On a Mac without it, everything measured works just the same. [...] Siteprint
